novelty_delta: Specializes finite-cover transfer to the labelled JANUS Z3 phase equation: phase obstruction is invariant under every cover of degree coprime to three, hence every 2-group cover; proves sharpness by an explicit connected degree-3 cover that repairs every connected phase obstruction; and records exact upward persistence of noncommutativity plus superlog-nullity preservation under polynomial-degree covers.
progress_claim: Closes the PA-0025 intermediate phase-persistence question and removes the need for new zero modes in polynomial-size covers. The filtered-family construction now reduces to finding a superlog-nullity noncommuting phase-FAIL base family and a polynomial-size 2-group high-girth/10-cycle cover mechanism, or proving that combination impossible.
